articles.title: Banks pass on rate hikes, but go slow when rates fall; RBI study finds
articles.summary: A recent study by the RBI indicates that banks are more responsive to interest rate hikes than to cuts. Specifically, banks relayed 76.4% of repo rate increases, while only 64% of reductions were passed on. Amid periods of tightening, lending rates surged significantly, in contrast to the minimal decreases observed during easing. This research highlights the intricate dynamics of interest rate adjustments, particularly affecting sectors like MSMEs.

articles.title: India’s labour survey to soon include platform workers and unpaid household work
articles.summary: India will update its Periodic Labour Force Survey starting January 2027 to enhance data collection. The modified sampling design aims to improve the identification of digital platform workers and unpaid household activities. Stakeholders are invited to provide feedback before the new sampling period begins.

articles.title: Industrial growth may ease to 6% in September as capital goods, mining lose steam
articles.summary: In September 2026, India's industrial production growth is anticipated to decline to 6%, down from 8% in August. Additionally, mining output is expected to contract by 8%, indicating a cooling growth trend, although vehicle sales and infrastructure goods remain robust.

articles.title: Foreign investors withdraw Rs 48,056 crore in October as market selling continues
articles.summary: Foreign Portfolio Investors have withdrawn Rs 48,056 crore from Indian equities during October due to high crude oil prices. Selling eased slightly in a recent week, with some FPIs becoming net buyers for two days. Elevated oil prices and inflation concerns are contributing to deteriorating corporate earnings outlooks affecting investor confidence. Domestic institutional investors have somewhat mitigated the selling pressure on markets in recent weeks.
